description: List the laws that require a caller or conversational agent to disclose that it is AI, a bot, or an artificial or prerecorded voice, for a US state, Canadian province or phone number, or for every jurisdiction. Covers the FCC ruling that AI-generated voices are artificial voices under the TCPA (so AI voice calls need prior express consent), the federal rule that prerecorded messages identify the caller at the start, state AI and chatbot disclosure laws, and state rules on identifying automated messages. Each rule gives what must be disclosed, when, who it applies to, effective and sunset dates, whether it is in force today, the citation, a verbatim quote, the source URL and as-of date. Informational, not legal advice.

phone_number.description: Instead of a state: a phone number; its area code gives the state.

state.description: A US state, DC, territory or Canadian province, as a code or name.
